text:
Maya Chen: Pushed a new set of page copy — hero, mode module (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), demo/signup flows. Need quick feedback for launch assets.
Oliver Park: On it. Quick question: what's our primary conversion metric here? Demo requests or self-serve trial starts?
Maya Chen: Rank: 1) demo signups (sales handoff) 2) self-serve trial 3) webinar signups. Demo leads should get AE routing when they indicate Dedicated/Private.
Sam R: Short heroes feel stronger. "Predictable throughput" is a bit dense. How about "consistent performance you can rely on"?
Priya Kaur: +1. For CTAs, recommend two visible actions: "Request demo" -> AE route, and "Start free trial" -> self-serve. Add a checkbox: "I need dedicated capacity or private deployment" to auto-flag enterprise.
Jordan: For webinar landing, surface a one-line benchmark tease: "Watch live: latency & cost benchmarks across deployment modes." Anchor in page so hero can jump to benchmarks.
Luis: Routing rules: if checkbox checked OR company_size > 200 => tag as enterprise => AE queue. Else nurture flow. I'll add Zapier mapping and AE Slack alert. :gear:
Maya Chen: Drafted three hero lines: A) "Powerful LLM inference, predictable costs" B) "Fast, reliable model serving for production" C) "Ship LLM features with predictable performance" Thoughts?
Oliver Park: Prefer C. Shorten slightly to "Ship LLM features with predictable performance."
Sam R: Add microcopy under CTAs: "Hosted API — quick start • Dedicated — predictable scale • Private — compliance-ready" Keep inline and compact.
Priya Kaur: Webinar headline: "Live benchmark: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private — latency, cost, routing tradeoffs." Keep under 100 chars.
Maya Chen: Added a tiny JS handler for routing — can someone confirm logic?
Maya Chen: ```
// form handler
if (formData.needsAE || formData.companySize > 200) {
  routeTo('ae_queue', {tag: 'enterprise', source: 'site-hero'});
} else {
  routeTo('nurture', {source: 'site-hero'});
}
```
Jordan: Add UTM: utm_medium=web, utm_campaign=launch_q2, utm_content=hero_C
Luis: Wiring UTMs + Zap now. Also splitting webinar regs into "Benchmarks" vs "Use-case" buckets based on interest checkbox.
Maya Chen: Timeline: please submit comments by EOD. We'll lock hero + CTA tomorrow morning to feed launch posts and webinar email sequences.
Sam R: A/B plan: hero C vs trimmed B for 7 days; measure demo CTA CTR and demo form conversions.
Priya Kaur: I'll draft webinar email and 3 social posts. Schedule: announcement, reminder, day-of. Also a short benchmark thread for LinkedIn.
launch-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2024-05-02 10:00 UTC — "Lock site copy for launch" :bell:
Maya Chen: Thanks — will make edits and ping when live. :rocket:
